method: Conservative human structural inspection of every current foreground picture in numbered review contacts plus prior all actual exported card review. Ignore labels,colours,IDs,institution aliases and minor positioning. Group similar useful mechanisms;different file identity does not prove meaningful composition.

repeated_groups.reason: Same actual emergency-entrance photograph retained for its cost continuation.
Person-to-clinic route grouped conservatively across repeated consent and refusal;tick/barrier conveys real opposite rights but does not earn another base composition.
Book/protected-patient motif grouped conservatively despite added surrounding rights-example objects.

limits: Empty repeated-groups means no comparable base geometry found in this manual pass,not proof from unique file hashes. Licensed photographs evaluated by actual scene/object composition and primary identity. No cosmetic changes or source/media edits.
